description: Enable an allowlisted Postgres extension on a branch. With name vector and search_table: true it also creates a semantic search table and match function. Scope: database:write.

organization_id.description: Organization id. Optional: defaults to the token's organization, or the only one you belong to.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional: defaults to the project created or used last in this session, or the only one.

schema.description: Schema to install it in. Optional.

search_table.description: With vector: also create the semantic search table

name: extensions.enable
title: Enable an extension
